meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去查 DepMap 的癌症细胞系基因依赖分数(CRISPR Chronos)、药敏数据和基因效应谱,据此找出癌症选择性依赖、合成致死关系,并回验肿瘤药物靶点。
howto.when: 当你要求验证某基因是否为癌症靶点、寻找合成致死伙伴,或分析化合物敏感性时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里的 Chronos 依赖分数
say.note: 返回各细胞系的依赖分数与阈值判断

say.text: 找 BRCA1 突变细胞系中选择性必需的基因
say.note: 输出候选合成致死伙伴列表

say.text: 这个基因是泛癌种必需还是只对某类癌症必需?

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude queries DepMap for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity and gene effect profiles, to find cancer-selective dependencies and synthetic lethal partners.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to validate a gene as a cancer target, look for synthetic lethal partners, or analyze compound sensitivity in DepMap.

say_en.text: Check the Chronos dependency score of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines
say_en.note: Returns dependency scores and threshold calls

say_en.text: Find genes selectively essential in BRCA1-mutant cell lines
Is this gene pan-essential or selective to one cancer type?
